_comment: Models are the primary entity: configure one, then tick the lanes it covers.
Two models on the same lane is the point, not a mistake - lanes buy coverage,
doubling up within a lane buys depth.
Any lane (correctness, security, contract, ux, gate) with no model
assigned is reported as NOT SWEPT and makes the run exit non-zero. It is never
silently omitted, because a missing lane reads exactly like a clean one.
Model ids are 'vendor:model'. A bare name means Claude. An empty model after
the colon means that CLI's own default. Note gpt-5.6-codex is not available on
Set use_agents to true on a Claude or Codex model to ask it to delegate
independent lane work in parallel. Claude uses two foreground Ultracode agents;
Codex chooses its fan-out. Kilo's read-only Ask agent cannot delegate.
